text:
alex: Heads-up: planning a controlled toggle for the feature flag `enable-adaptive-batcher` in prod tonight. Window 02:00-03:00 PDT. Plan is: 50% for 15m smoke, run checks, then 100% if metrics ok. Primary deployer: maya. Safe default = false (flag off). Anyone object or have extra checks?

maya: SG. I'll own the deploy and be on-call for the hour. How are we splitting the 50% cohort — random by tenant id or sticky routing? Also what's the exact rollback command if things go sideways?

alex: Use sticky by tenant hash so the same tenants stay in the cohort. Rollback is immediate set to 0.0 (safe default). Quick CLI to flip:

```bash
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/api/v1/flags/enable-adaptive-batcher -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLAG_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"weight":0.0, "cohort":"batcher-gradual-199812"}'
```

If you need to revert to the original state (fully off) that's weight=0.0; to pause at 50% use weight=0.5; to fully enable weight=1.0. I'll keep the runbook link handy: https://runbook.internal/deploys/feature-flags#adaptive-batcher

jordan: Key metrics to watch: p50/p95 latency for text-gen endpoints, per-token cost (tokens/sec), error-rate (5xx + latency timeouts), and serving queue depth. Dashboards: https://grafana.internal/d/abc123/adaptive-batcher-smoke . If p95 > baseline * 1.3 or 5xx > 0.5% over 5m, call rollback.

sam: I'll monitor traces and SLO alerts. If I see a spike in timeout traces tied to the caching layer, should we also flip the `batcher-cache-enabled` gate? Might help isolate failures.

maya: Good call. Default plan: keep `batcher-cache-enabled=true`. Only flip cache gate if traces point to cache-induced regressions. I'll coordinate with sam if that happens.

ci-deploy-bot: Scheduled job created: rollout/enable-adaptive-batcher/1998123456 queued for 1998123456. Notifying on-call.

maya: Starting 50% cohort now (02:00 PDT). I will post status at +5m and +15m.

alex: Thanks — I'll watch the graphs and ready to flip to 0.0 instantly if thresholds hit. If 15m smoke clean, plan is to go to 100% at ~02:20 PDT and then verify for 10m before closing the window.

maya: +5m: no visible error spike, p95 within 10% baseline, queue depth normal. Proceeding to hold until +15m.

maya: +15m: stable. Promoting to 100% now.

ci-deploy-bot: rollout/enable-adaptive-batcher/1998123456 status: promoted to 100% at 1998126256.

maya: Done — 100% live. Sam/jordan please confirm no regressions on your end.

jordan: Confirmed: p50/p95 look good, error-rate steady. No anomalous traces.

sam: Traces clean, no cache alerts. All good from infra side.

alex: Great — closing this rollout. Will update the changelog and add note to the feature-flag audit. Thanks everyone. :tada:
